exceptions.rationale: The GL records $69,971.32, which is $416.20 below the invoice and bank deposit of $70,387.52.

The invoice is dated 2025-12-30, but the bill of lading shows all 317 units shipped on 2026-01-03, after year-end. The shipment does not support 2025 recognition; the GL posting date was not provided.

judgments.rationale: The invoice bills 304 units, but the bill of lading shows only 289 shipped on 2025-06-21. The deposit matches the full invoice, but no shipment evidence supports the remaining 15 units.
